en.authorizationExpired: Authorization failed. Auto-refresh paused. Authenticate again, then refresh.
en.balanceBuiltIn: Built-in adapter; no setup needed, editing replaces it
en.balanceConflict: This provider script changed. Your input is retained. Review the latest version.
en.balanceNativePaused: Queries paused; enable to resume native balance queries
en.balanceNativeSource: Managed by the desktop account service; custom scripts do not apply
en.billingCatalogFailed: Could not load the model catalog. Retry.
en.billingConflict: Billing rules changed. Your draft is retained. Load the latest rules and reapply your changes.
en.billingExternalChange: Billing rules changed in the background. Your unsaved changes are retained.
en.billingInherited: These prices inherit the shared rules from {provider} and are read-only here. Editing the shared rules affects every official route still inheriting them; accounts with their own rules are unaffected.
en.billingInvalid: Check prices, periods and tier limits.
en.billingLoadLatest: Discard draft and load latest rules
en.billingMultiplierInvalid: Multiplier must be finite and positive. Leave blank for 1.
en.billingNoModels: No models for this provider or search
en.billingNoTemplate: No default template for this model
en.billingPeriodHint: Select hours and minutes; the end may be 24:00. Other times are off-peak. Split overnight periods into two.
en.billingPeriodTierHint: Configure tiers separately for each period. Without tiers, use the base prices above. Limits include cached input; leave the final limit blank.
en.billingSaved: Saved. Applies to new records only.
en.billingSaveFailed: Could not save. Your draft is retained. Retry.
en.billingSplit: Resize model list and pricing editor
en.billingTemplateWarning: Applying replaces this model’s prices, periods and tiers and saves automatically.
en.billingTierHint: Limits include cached input. Leave the final limit blank. Configured tiers supply the unit prices.
en.errorHistory: Failure collection begins when this feature is enabled. Missing historical latency is shown as not recorded.
en.errorSafe: Only classification and HTTP status are retained. Request content and credentials are not stored.
en.feeFrozen: These facts come from the frozen ledger, without recalculating at current rates.
en.feeMissing: Missing historical rates, modes and sources are shown as Not recorded.
en.feeRounding: Each amount is tokens ÷ 1,000,000 × rate × multiplier. Totals use unrounded amounts; the list displays 6 decimal places.
en.historicalSnapshot: Historical snapshot: rows and reading position stay fixed. Overview still updates; new data may be available. Refresh to see the latest first page.
en.invalidTime: Enter valid dates with the end after the start.
en.modulesBillingDescription: Official/custom pricing, balances and debit animations
en.modulesCurrentMissing: GitHub has no compatible module for the current version. Upgrade to version {version} to restore?
en.modulesNoPackage: This release has no compatible module package
en.modulesNote: Removed modules are never automatically reinstalled. Background usage collection continues until the entire plugin is uninstalled.
en.modulesNotifyDescription: Budget, anomaly, peak alerts and pet bubbles
en.modulesOverviewDescription: Overview, usage details and history queries
en.modulesPetDescription: Whale animations, dragging and pet assets
en.modulesRestart: Installed. Restart DSH to load the new version.
en.modulesRestoreExact: Download the exact matching version {version} from GitHub.
en.modulesRestoreUpgrade: Version {version} is available. Upgrade the entire plugin while restoring?
en.modulesRisk: Selected features stop immediately and their runtime files are physically deleted. Unchecked configuration or history is also deleted permanently. Restoring requires an online download.
en.modulesStar: Open GitHub project to star it
en.modulesWechatDescription: Login, connection, test messages and delivery
en.modulesWholeRisk: Stop the entire plugin, background collection and management entry, then physically delete runtime files. Restoring requires installing the plugin again. Unchecked configuration or history is permanently deleted.
en.overviewDailyHint: Selected-period spend ÷ days with eligible usage records. No active days: —.
en.overviewPer100mHint: Selected-period spend ÷ tokens in the same period × 100 million. No tokens: —.
en.overviewScope: Shares time and provider filters with the list below · Beijing time
en.pageUnavailable: Page {page} · Total pages and rows currently unavailable
en.resetConfirm: Reset filters to today, all models, all projects and all conversations, and return to the first usage page? No usage records will be deleted.
en.sessionIdentityConflict: Session identity conflict / cost pending review
en.sessionIdentityConflictHint: Conflicting raw session identities prevent reliable attribution. Amounts and counters for this session and dependent totals are withheld; the ledger is unchanged.
en.staleData: Last successful data retained; values may be stale.
en.timingHint: First token: green ≤5s, amber ≤15s, otherwise red. Total: green ≤60s, amber ≤180s, otherwise red. First token includes reasoning, text or tool output.
